title: Geometric Neuron: from maximal story to falsifiable mechanisms
summary: A version-number ladder that turns out to contain several different scientific objects: maximal physical stories, operator/signal-processing work, and later autopsy/reset repos.

nodes.claim: Freezes and mechanically re-audits the PerceptionLab ECG loop that helped start the later line.
nodes.survived: Bounded observation inside feedback can change the trajectory; changing vector size changed the measurement operator.
nodes.killed: The four feedback values were not four eigenmodes; the ECG-like rhythm did not require a hidden neuron model.

nodes.claim: Maximal early physical story: dendrites as Takens unfoldings, soma recurrence geometry and AIS as Moiré interferometer.
nodes.survived: Delay geometry, resonance, and the intuition that receiver structure changes what is observable.
nodes.killed: The ECG loop was later shown not to prove eigenmode selection or a Geometric-Neuron mechanism; many biological identity claims were not earned.

nodes.claim: Extended the physicalist neuron story with a self-tuning AIS grating and morphological plasticity.
nodes.survived: Morphology as a controllable physical parameter and resonance-search as an experimental motif.
nodes.killed: AIS-as-Moiré-grating and morphology-replaces-weights were not established biological mechanisms.

nodes.claim: Introduced an explicit bilinear cross-time chirality readout and an honest Wiener–Khinchin boundary.
nodes.survived: L = Im(z·conj(z_lag)) as a direction-sensitive readout; sparse delta-code; explicit verified/built-in/bet ledger.
nodes.killed: Linear or second-order delay readouts cannot by themselves recover phase/orbit direction; earlier sine-vs-square evidence was spectral, not phase evidence.

nodes.claim: Moved read-template learning onto a Stiefel/Oja coverage objective and exposed a data-blind diversity control.
nodes.survived: Subspace coverage must be optimized against the data, not merely by pushing templates apart.
nodes.killed: Frame-potential orthogonalization made templates diverse without materially increasing captured signal energy.

nodes.claim: Reads direction from the skew half of lag covariance; its antisymmetric eigenplanes become emergent rotation islands.
nodes.survived: Skew lag operator A=(C_tau-C_tau^T)/2 cleanly carries directed structure; learned Stiefel/Oja flow recovers the same planes.
nodes.killed: V8's symmetric covariance objective was direction-blind; hand-assigned directed edge pairings were no longer necessary in the synthetic tour.

nodes.claim: Runs the skew operator on a live sensory surface and closes a predict/correct dead-reckoning loop.
nodes.survived: Streaming receptive fields, causal chirality flips and held-velocity prediction through sensory blackout.
nodes.killed: The EC/hippocampus and theta-sweep biological mappings remain functional analogies, not identified circuitry.

nodes.claim: Curated recomposition of the load-bearing organs of the line, explicitly separating verified results, killed claims and bets.
nodes.survived: V5 chirality, V9 skew operator, active directionality and explicit failure ledgers were treated as the reusable spine. Crucially for the current temporal/field thread, the curation also preserves `03_faces_of_A/generate/whorl_field.py` and `whorl_README.md`, copied from `ArtificialCortex/the_whorl`, so the old spiral-field experiment is not lost inside the larger ArtificialCortex archive.
nodes.killed: The recomposition records multiple retired claims, including passive geometric directionality and geometry-replaces-weights.

nodes.claim: Autopsy of the founding ECG anomaly: quantized aliasing map plus finite-memory variance thermostat, not the later operator neuron.
nodes.survived: Readout geometry changes dynamical regime; the tap test directly confirmed that which pixels are observed can decide life/death of the loop.
nodes.killed: The ECG loop equals the V9–V20 Geometric Neuron; jump-spectrum criterion; fixed-point explanation; phase-addressed memory retrieval under the old null.

nodes.claim: External-test repo: abstract graph/modal features initially looked strong, then lost their advantage under common-synapse control.
nodes.survived: Writable spatial state + selective readout + feedback as a narrower research object; provenance discipline.
nodes.killed: The tested abstract graph/modal features did not explain morphology-dependent FCI beyond ordinary size/path geometry under the clean control.

nodes.claim: Conceptual reset: geometry constrains coupling, local mechanisms carry history, and receiver choice defines which distinctions are visible.
nodes.survived: Geometry × local state × event-driven transitions × receiver-relative readout, with explicit shuffle/ablation obligations.
nodes.killed: Geometry alone is no longer treated as the computation; V23 explicitly has not yet earned a positive experimental result.

nodes.claim: Tests whether separated local routes preserve causal identity and can adapt the lifetime and temporal mode of that causal state.
nodes.survived: Route-attached eligibility, adaptive causal lifetime and a movable local resonant pole under mixed delayed consequences.
nodes.killed: A fixed resonator bank does not generalize off-grid; V25 is not evidence that neurons literally run genetic algorithms.

motifs.title: Direction needs an antisymmetric object
motifs.description: V5 finds a bilinear direction readout; V9 locates directed structure in the skew lag operator; V21 keeps direction as the surviving reason phase-like structure is needed.

motifs.title: Observation can change the regime
motifs.description: The founding ECG autopsy and V24 both show that address/readout choice is part of the dynamics or identifiability problem, not a passive logger.

motifs.title: Negative results prune the theory
motifs.description: V8, V21 and V22 remove attractive but unsupported mechanisms and force narrower descendants.
